strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
I underestimated Earth's military. I never imagined they had such power.
...But! My target is Mia Alice... Heh heh... Come on...!
Gil! Why do you...!
I've been waiting for you, Mia Alice...!
Earth's robots got in my way on the ground, but not this time!
This is where you'll be buried...!
Heh, sore loser, huh! We don't need the Earthlings' help!
We'll send you to your grave right here!
You mock me... Heh, very well. I have an interesting guest for you.
They should arrive shortly.
Interesting guest? Don't bother trying to scare us with nonsense!
Oh ho... Lamba Nom, are you sure about that? Heh heh heh...
?? Is something wrong with you? Creepy!
You'll see soon enough... If you're still in one piece by then!
Attack!
Gil Berg! Don't think a force like that can beat Dangaioh!
You're the one who's underestimating us! Here we go!
...Gil's confidence... What is it...?
Muohh!?
So this is it! The point where the Bunker mecha appeared!
Hmm!? So fast...!
There's a military that can move this quickly not just on the
ground, but deployed in space too...!?
They're fighting each other? Ah, Captain Bright, could it be...
We're still checking, but most likely...
An Earth battleship!?
What, so Gil's big surprise is Earth's military?
What a letdown.
Doesn't look like it. Gil seems rattled too.
People of Earth! We are...
Dangaioh... Are you the Dangaioh team!?
I'm Bright Noa of Londo Bell, an independent Federation unit.
An independent unit...! The one Commander Hazuki told us about...
Now that's lucky! Saves us the trouble of explaining everything!
All riiight, let's go!
All units, launch! They're allies! Support Dangaioh!
Let's go, everyone! Don't fall behind those Londo Bell guys!
Hey, there are space pirates among the enemy this time, right?
Do you think they've got sailing-ship spaceships flying skull flags?
Sorry, no mothership-type enemies.
Along with Bunker, units of the space crime syndicate Gyandlar confirmed.
Space pirates and a space crime syndicate!? This is insane!
Geez, anything goes now, huh?
Ooh, so we're warriors of justice, boldly standing up to the
villains who ravage the universe! I'm fired up!
Anyway, all our units, launch too! Repel the enemy quickly!
...Sink the pirates fast... no time to arrr-gue. ...Heh... Hyahyahya!!
Space pirates Bunker...! I won't let you have your way!
Heard you gave the Gandor team a hard time! Now you pay up!
Let's take them down good, Koji!
We'll beat 'em to a pulp, I tell ya!
While I was at that abandoned colony... you ran wild down on Earth!
You'll pay for all the trouble you caused...!
Tch, here before my reinforcements... Londo Bell...
Come to think of it, they're the ones who stopped our descent to Earth!
New units in the combat area. Not friendly IFF signals.
Th-that means...
Enemy reinforcements!?
These are the guys Gil meant by his big surprise!?
Don't make me laugh! Numbers alone won't cut it!
But... they look quite powerful. We can't let our guard down.
That's right, Pai.
...I doubt he simply called his friends... What are you after, Gil?
Heh heh heh... You've come. Your enemy is aboard that Dangaioh.
All I want is to kill Mia Alice...!
We both have the same target!
Aliens with grudges and revenge... What a bloodthirsty bunch.
If you wanna squabble, do it somewhere far from Earth.
What was that!? Quit whining like that, you call yourself a man!?
You started this fight on your own, so what's with that attitude!?
Shinobu! Cut it out, don't pick fights with our allies!
That's right! And Pai, stop snapping back at him!
I'm too stunned to even speak.
...I'm sorry.
What are you doing!? Here they come!
Shinobu! Save it for later! Honestly!
...!! You're... Shazara!
Lamba!? You know her?
Shazara! It's you, Shazara! I missed you... Have you forgotten!?
It's me, Lamba, the one you took care of! Remember!?
What's she doing? Is that... an ally?
Oh, nice. Why not just bring her over to our side?
It's not that simple... Besides, it looks complicated.
In the middle of battle!? Don't tell me... she's colluding with them...
Listen carefully, Tetsuya. They seem to... know each other.
Dangaioh is approaching what seems to be the reinforcements' leader.
It appears to be making contact.
What? What on earth are they thinking...?
Maybe she knows that pilot?
...If so, maybe she can talk them into backing off!
Here's hoping.
No... If this is what Gil meant... Lamba! That woman is...!
What on earth is going on!? What are they doing!?
She's gotten too close, carelessly. Captain, can you pick them up?
...No, I can't make it out. There seems to be jamming.
A secret talk in the middle of battle, huh?
Captain Bright, Grendizer's comm system may pick it up.
Let me listen in.
I haven't forgotten... Princess Lamba...
Shazara... Then why!?
I don't forget a hated enemy so easily...!
Heh heh heh... Do you remember now, Lamba Nom?
Must be strange, seeing your old handmaiden as your enemy.
Lamba, what does this mean!?
...I remember... I was happy with my kind father and mother...
But... that day, Bunker didn't overlook Lilith...
Planet Lilith...? Princess? I see, so one of Dangaioh's pilots...
Brother!? You know about this?
Planet Lilith, of the Central Eighth Star System... Like Fleed,
I heard it was a rich world ruled by a royal family.
There were rumors it lost a war of invasion and fell...
So the invader was Bunker?
I cut my hair to fool Bunker... and fled into space in an escape pod.
My parents stayed on the planet to fight Bunker...
The handmaiden who stayed with me to the very end... was Shazara...
Your father, who preached resistance to the bitter end...
handed the planet right over to Bunker... out of fear.
Gil! What happened to Lilith... to my planet!? Answer me!
Surely you know how Bunker does things. Heh heh heh...
The only survivors were me, a handful of others... and you, Princess!
It all happened because of a spineless royal family...
You can't blame the people for hating you as traitors, Princess...
Heh heh, hahahaha!
To wipe out the blood of the traitorous royal family...
I've wandered this universe, even becoming one of Bunker...!
No! Killing Lamba... won't bring back the people of Lilith!
Tch, with someone like that... nothing we say will...!
Princess Lamba... Now you'll answer for the grudge of Lilith's people!
Gil Berg...! So this is how you operate!? I won't forgive you...!
Shut up! Winning is all that matters! Winning!
Shazara...
Why not just finish me, Princess Lamba!? To laugh at me...
...a woman who fights only for revenge!?
You! Don't you get how Lamba feels!?
That day...! The king forsook our world! He let Bunker in at the end.
And as a result... our planet, Lilith...!
Did the king really surrender to the invaders... just out of fear...!?
...What!? An Earthling talking like you know...
I am of the royal family... of planet Fleed.
Fleed was attacked by the Vega Star Federation... and destroyed...!
Fleed...!? You're not from Earth!?
The people of Fleed... were never given a choice.
The Vega Star Federation gave them nothing but one-sided death!
Daisuke...
Daisuke...
And I... fled in this Grendizer...
...To defeat King Vega, so no such tragedy would ever happen again...
I abandoned my planet...!
Shazara... Did Father and Mother hand our planet over to Bunker
just to be conquered...? Wasn't it to save everyone on Lilith...?
...That...
Then isn't the enemy we truly have to defeat Bunker!?
Killing me... might make you feel better...
But Bunker will just do the same thing again, won't they...?
Princess... Lamba...
If you can't forgive me... the royal family, you can kill me.
But before that, there's something we have to do, Shazara!
Princess... Let me believe in the royal family once more... Princess Lamba...!
Shazara...!
Acquired skill "Rebellious Spirit".
Ugh... Princess... Lamba.
I... I lived only to avenge the fallen people of Lilith...!
I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, Shazara...
I owe you... so many apologies.
...Lamba.
But... we can't fall here...
For the people of Lilith who died too... we'll fight...!
We'll fight Bunker... So, please...!
Don't mock me! Then what about my grudge...!
...I'll... finish her off...!
Roll... Let me...
Huh...?
Let me... finish her...!
...All right.
Roll!?
Princess... Perhaps I was... waiting for this day...
Ugh... ugh... Ah, waaaaaaah...!
Lamba...
Spiral Knuckle is now available.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
The space pirates Bunker... It seems they're finally making their move.
Still, what a sickening bunch...!
Koji...
But... they're persistent and vile. Exploiting love for one's homeland...!
Tetsuya...
...Homeland, huh?
Brother...
Maria, don't worry. I won't let scum like that defile Earth...!
Captain, what about those people?
Dangaioh, was it?
Yes... I've heard of them from Commander Hazuki and Dr. Tarsan.
What, the doc already pulled strings that far?
He's as quick as ever with that sort of thing.
We share a common enemy. What do you say... will you work with us?
I don't intend to treat you badly...
Mia, it's to protect your homeland... Earth. All right?
Yes...! I don't know how much help we'll be... but we'll cooperate.
And give us the scoop on Bunker too, 'kay?
A four-pilot robot like Dancougar. Looks like we've got a rival, huh?
Hmph, compared to Dancougar...
I told you to shut it, didn't I? A man shouldn't run his mouth.
What!? You picked a fight with me earlier too, you!
...Sigh.
These two sure are alike.
Bunker, you say...
They seem to rob every planet they visit of its resources and people...
True villains of the universe.
But coming to Earth, home of Gai Daigoji, was their bad luck!
Just you watch!
Yeah, yeah, sure, Yamada... But their mecha were really tough.
We can't let our guard down.
They go around plundering the universe. Won't be easy to deal with.
When I heard "pirates," I pictured something way more romantic.
It's just an army of mobile mecha.
Bunker was something, but those Dangaioh team people...
Their pilot suits are really something...
Oh my, Akito, is that your type?
No! That's not it!
It's just, um... I don't know where to look... Right, XO?
Huh? Oh, well, those outfits are certainly... how to put it...
Hmm... If Akito likes them, maybe I'll wear a suit like that too!
And then, like, strike a pose...
...!! No way! A captain not wearing her uniform!?
More to the point, please consider your age.
Ugh... Geez, Megumi, Ruri, you're so strict...
Princess Lamba...
Let's fight... Shazara.
We lost our planet, but Lilith lives on in our hearts... So...
Princess...
I'm glad, Lamba...
Truly... Bunker... I'll never forgive them.
Lamba?
Shazara... I... I...
Lamba... that's enough.
Roll Kran. There are no words we can offer her right now...
...Yes, sir...
